tests.question: What is the maximum gross vehicle weight allowed for five-axle vehicles on Georgia state roadways under the petroleum supply state of emergency?
tests.referenceAnswer: Vehicles with five weight-bearing axles and an outer bridge span of at least 51 feet may not exceed a gross vehicle weight of 95,000 pounds, a maximum width of 10 feet, and an overall length of 100 feet on state-maintained roadways, excluding interstates.

tests.question: Which fuel taxes did the Governor suspend in the petroleum supply state of emergency, and under what legal authority?
tests.referenceAnswer: Under Code Section 45-12-22(b), the Governor suspended collection of the motor and diesel fuel taxes required by Code Section 48-9-3 during the state of emergency, subject to ratification by the General Assembly. Under Code Section 45-12-22(a), the Governor also suspended the Code Section 48-8-30 tax on fuel sold to contract or common carriers regulated by the United States Surface Transportation Board for their exclusive use.

tests.question: When does Georgia's state of emergency for petroleum supply disruptions take effect and when does it expire?
tests.referenceAnswer: The order was signed on September 28, 2026, takes effect Tuesday, September 29, 2026, and is valid for 30 days, expiring Thursday, October 29, 2026 at 11:59 P.M. unless the Governor renews the State of Emergency.
